entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane on the brink of a full-scale Mirran-Phyrexian war.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invaders emerging from the hidden spaces of Mirrodin to launch a major offensive.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: The white-aligned humans of the Razor Fields, organized in small city-state settlements.

entities.name: Accorders
entities.description: Traveling Auriok soldiers and spellcasters who protect settlements and enforce Auriok law under the Accord of Equity.

entities.name: Bladehold
entities.description: The largest Auriok settlement, a center of commerce and artisanship on a mesa above razorgrass.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: The blue-aligned humans who are second-class citizens under the vedalken and rely on serum.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: The blue folk whose Synod rules the Quicksilver Sea.

entities.name: The Synod
entities.description: The vedalken brain trust that solidified power after Memnarch's fall.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The fallen planar caretaker of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Covalt network
entities.description: A powerful Neurok network led by Vy Covalt.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: Leader of the Covalt network.

entities.name: Vrist network
entities.description: A powerful Neurok network led by Kala Vrist.

entities.name: Kala Vrist
entities.description: Leader of the Vrist network.

entities.name: Battle of the Synod
entities.description: A massive battle in which the Neurok defeated the Synod after powering down the vedalken drones.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The capital of the Quicksilver Sea, shared by vedalken above and Neurok below.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Humans adapted to life in the Mephidross.

entities.name: Disciples of Geth
entities.description: The Moriok who live in Ish Sah, the Vault of Whispers.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Iron-covered humans of the Oxidda Chain, organized into forge-tribes.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A young Vulshok earth-magic savant from the Hammer tribe who purifies ore for the Anvil tribe.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: The place through which all of Oxidda's molten metal passes.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: The humans of the Tangle, druids and shamans who worship the natural world.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: A young Sylvok druid who became de facto leader after the Vanishing.

entities.name: Araneas Altar
entities.description: A Sylvok shrine built around the former Radix to honor Lord Araneas.

entities.name: Lord Araneas
entities.description: A mythological spider-lord from Tangle folklore.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A figure involved with some Sylvok leaders in the battles against Memnarch.

entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: The event in which the elder generations of Mirrans disappeared.

events.summary: The Neurok strike the vedalken by powering down their hoverguards and wanderguards, leading to the Battle of the Synod in which the Synod is defeated.
events.quote: The Synod was defeated, but hundreds died on both sides

events.summary: Neurok and vedalken leaders reach an uneasy truce, trading serum for knowledge.
events.quote: Leaders between the Neurok and the vedalken reached an uneasy truce.

events.summary: Flashback: the Nim Onslaught harms the Moriok after the Vanishing.
events.quote: Here is one account of the Nim Onslaught, which occurred after the Vanishing

events.summary: The Anvil tribe's ingots turn brittle, and the Vulshok forge-tribes go to open war.
events.quote: For the first time in generations, there was open war among the Vulshok.

events.summary: Koth emerges as a leader and offers to purify ore for the Anvil tribe, slowing the skirmishes.
events.quote: He approached the Anvil and offered his help.

events.summary: The Sylvok build the Araneas Altar around the former Radix after the Fifth Dawn.
events.quote: They called it the Araneas Altar, an eight-sided construct to honor Lord Araneas

events.summary: Benzir takes a vision quest and concludes the Vanished have ascended into animals, starting Sylvok animal worship.
events.quote: Benzir told his tribe that spirits of the Vanished had been housed in animal bodies.
